focus.title: 美欧出口管制再收紧，中国半导体企业面临供应链重构与合规新挑战
focus.summary: 本周，美国商务部产业安全局进一步扩大对华半导体设备及先进制程芯片的出口管制范围，新增多项受限物项，并强化对第三国转口交易的审查；欧盟亦同步推进外国补贴条例的执法细则，对中资企业在欧投资并购提出更严格的信息披露要求。这一系列动向标志着主要经济体在技术脱钩与供应链安全上的博弈持续深化。对于中国出海企业而言，需高度关注管制清单的动态更新、最终用户审查的趋严趋势，以及由此引发的供应链重构成本与合规风险。建议企业建立动态合规监测机制，对涉及管制物项的跨境交易进行前置性筛查，并积极评估替代供应链方案。
focus.source: 来源：美国商务部产业安全局、欧盟委员会公告 · 本周
focus.title_en: US-EU Export Controls Tighten, Posing New Supply Chain and Compliance Challenges for Chinese Semiconductor Firms
focus.summary_en: This week, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security expanded export controls on semiconductor equipment and advanced chips destined for China, adding new restricted items and intensifying scrutiny of transshipment via third countries. Meanwhile, the EU advanced enforcement rules under its Foreign Subsidies Regulation, imposing stricter disclosure requirements on Chinese investments and acquisitions in Europe. These moves underscore deepening technological decoupling and supply chain security concerns among major economies. Chinese companies going global must closely monitor dynamic updates to control lists, the trend of stricter end-user checks, and the associated costs and compliance risks of supply chain restructuring. It is recommended that companies establish dynamic compliance monitoring mechanisms, conduct pre-screening of cross-border transactions involving controlled items, and proactively evaluate alternative supply chain options.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. BIS, European Commission announcements · this week

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心涉中企合资纠纷裁决获中国法院承认，跨境争议解决路径更明晰
case.summary: 本周，某中级人民法院裁定承认并执行新加坡国际仲裁中心就一起涉及中国企业与境外合作方合资协议纠纷作出的仲裁裁决。该案中，仲裁庭依据合同约定的适用法律与仲裁规则，就股权回购、违约责任等核心争议作出裁决。法院在审查中严格遵循《纽约公约》及中国相关司法解释，未发现存在拒绝承认与执行的情形。此案对出海企业具有重要启示：跨境交易中应审慎选择仲裁地、仲裁机构及适用法律，确保仲裁条款的明确性与可执行性；同时，在争议发生后，应充分利用国际仲裁的一裁终局优势，并关注中国法院对境外裁决承认与执行的司法实践，以有效维护自身权益。
case.source: 来源：中国裁判文书网公开信息 · 2026年8月
case.title_en: Singapore SIAC Award in Sino-Foreign JV Dispute Recognized by Chinese Court, Clarifying Cross-Border Dispute Resolution Paths
case.summary_en: This week, an intermediate people's court ruled to recognize and enforce a Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) award in a dispute involving a Chinese enterprise and a foreign partner over a joint venture agreement. The tribunal resolved core issues such as share buybacks and breach of contract under the governing law and arbitration rules chosen by the parties. The court's review strictly followed the New York Convention and relevant Chinese judicial interpretations, finding no grounds for refusal. This case offers important lessons for Chinese companies going global: they should carefully select the seat, institution, and governing law in cross-border transactions to ensure the clarity and enforceability of arbitration clauses; after a dispute arises, they should leverage the finality of international arbitration and keep abreast of Chinese judicial practice on recognition and enforcement to effectively protect their interests.
case.source_en: Source: China Judgments Online public information · August 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规出台，企业合规流通路径更清晰
policy.summary: 本周，广东省相关部门联合发布了关于粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动的若干规定，明确了在大湾区内开展数据跨境传输的合规路径、安全评估要求及标准合同条款范本。新规在现有法律法规框架下，进一步细化了数据处理者进行跨境数据提供的程序性要求，并针对金融、医疗、交通等重点行业提出了更具体的管理措施。此举旨在促进大湾区数据要素高效有序流动，同时保障国家安全与个人信息权益。对于在大湾区布局的出海企业而言，应尽快对照新规梳理自身数据处理活动，完善数据合规体系，尤其是涉及个人信息和重要数据的场景，需及时开展风险评估并履行相应备案义务，以把握政策红利并规避合规风险。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室等 · 2026年8月
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules for Greater Bay Area Issued, Providing Clearer Compliance Paths for Enterprises
policy.summary_en: This week, relevant departments in Guangdong Province jointly issued regulations on cross-border data flows within the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), clarifying compliance routes, security assessment requirements, and standard contractual clauses for cross-border data transfers. The new rules further specify procedural requirements for data processors, with more detailed management measures for key sectors such as finance, healthcare, and transportation, while staying within the existing legal framework. They aim to promote efficient and orderly data flow in the GBA while safeguarding national security and personal information rights. Companies operating in the GBA should promptly review their data processing activities against the new rules, enhance data compliance systems—especially for scenarios involving personal information and important data—conduct risk assessments in a timely manner, and fulfill filing obligations to capitalize on policy benefits and mitigate compliance risks.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province, etc. · August 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：出海企业应构建“管制清单+供应链+争议解决”三位一体风控体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周出口管制升级与跨境数据新规出台，凸显外部监管环境复杂多变。建议出海企业：一、建立动态合规监测机制，专人跟踪美欧等主要市场管制清单与执法动态，对交易对手及最终用户做穿透式审查；二、评估供应链韧性，对关键元器件和软件进行“去风险”备份，并利用保税区或海外仓优化物流节点；三、完善合同与争议解决条款，优先选择新加坡、香港等成熟仲裁地，明确适用法律，避免管辖不确定性；四、在大湾区业务中，加快数据合规体系建设，对标新规完成评估备案。下周重点关注美国对华关税政策调整、欧盟外国补贴条例具体案例适用，以及RCEP框架下原产地规则利用机会。
analysis.source: 来源：律连全球研究团队 · 2026年8月14日
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Outbound Firms Should Build a 'Control List + Supply Chain + Dispute Resolution' Integrated Risk Control System
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's export control escalation and new cross-border data rules underscore a complex and volatile regulatory environment. It is recommended that Chinese companies going global: 1) Establish dynamic compliance monitoring mechanisms, assign dedicated personnel to track control lists and enforcement trends in major markets like the US and EU, and conduct look-through screening of counterparties and end-users; 2) Assess supply chain resilience by creating 'de-risked' backups for critical components and software, and optimize logistics nodes using bonded zones or overseas warehouses; 3) Strengthen contract and dispute resolution clauses, prioritizing mature arbitration seats such as Singapore and Hong Kong with clear governing law to avoid jurisdictional uncertainty; 4) Accelerate data compliance system building in GBA operations, aligning with new rules and completing assessments and filings. Next week, watch for adjustments in US tariffs on China, concrete application of the EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation, and opportunities under RCEP rules of origin.
analysis.source_en: Source: iGlobal Law Research Team · August 14, 2026
